steps.code:
# Parse the note content to extract song titles and artists
import re

content = note['content']
lines = [line.strip() for line in content.split('\n') if line.strip() and not line.startswith('#')]
songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Split on " by " to separate title and artist(s)
    if ' by ' in line:
        title, artists = line.split(' by ', 1)
        songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists.strip()})
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        songs.append({'title': line, 'artists': ''})

print(songs)
